restlet.description: Describe, download, list, create, edit and delete File Cabinet files over JSON — NetSuite's REST API has no file-content support. Primarily called by netsuite-cli via `restlet call`; contract documented in the local cp-file-cabinet skill. GET ?id=|path= describes; &contents=T downloads; ?folder= lists; POST creates; PUT patches; DELETE removes a file.
restlet.name: CP | File Cabinet RESTlet
